meta.title: Band
meta.description: Garden Psychedelia — psychedelia from Campos dos Goytacazes (RJ) since 2019, five members.

band.headline: Original since 2019.
band.quote: The apotheosis of friendship. The energetic explosion born of aesthetics and demand. Garden exists to meet the need for genuine expression.
band.about: Since 2019, by friends and for everyone. Our foundation is rock and roll, but our references are bigger than our labels. We live in the making, but we court the crowd. We want to provoke you, we want to impress you. Calendar always open.
band.live: With five shows across different rooms and gatherings, 2025 was a year of expansion and consolidation for Garden on stage, strengthening the link between its original music and the community that moves the city’s independent culture. In 2026, Garden opens a new chapter with the single “DBAWOT” and a new EP on the way.

shows.headline: Shows, festivals, and Weird Parties.
shows.ourEventsBody: If the scene won’t hold you, hold the scene. Weird Parties are the nights Garden puts together — lineup, room, poster, built by us with other artists — so we can play the stage we wanted and bring others with us. Four so far, between Halloween and Christmas editions.
shows.alreadyHappenedBody: One festival, four Weird Parties, and plenty of other stories.

music.ep1Blurb: Éter, Morning Riser, Cos I Lov U and @Me — four tracks, one breath. Still in the works, still changing shape, but they already exist.
